drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price rose 1.6% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -5.4% to +9.2% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 4.6% on average at 30 days, vs 3.8% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 60% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see a new MSP, government wheat sales (OMSS), the size of the next harvest, or export/stock-limit rules - news like that can move the price outside the range.

rules.english:
2026-10-26 Wheat - SELL (score -1 of 5.5): If buying: Avoid stocking - buy hand-to-mouth.  If holding: Sell gradually - prices may soften.
Why: Mainly because the price is near the top of the year's range.
What would change it: Turns HOLD if the price falls to Rs 2,738 (-5.0%). Stays SELL even if it rises 15%.
How sure: Low. Past SELL days (987 since 2016): lower 30 days later on 54% vs 43% of all days -> edge +11 points.
Price: Rs 2,883/qtl (benchmark mandis), 7 days +13.8%, 30 days +8.1%. 30-day outlook Rs 2,923 (likely Rs 2,728 - Rs 3,148).
Cheapest to bring to Srikakulam: Itarsi APMC at Rs 2,962/qtl landed (mandi Rs 2,545 + freight Rs 324).
Cheapest to bring to Hyderabad: Itarsi APMC at Rs 2,878/qtl landed (mandi Rs 2,545 + freight Rs 240).
Season: cheapest in Apr & May, dearest in Nov & Dec (about 14% swing).
rules.telugu:
2026-10-26 గోధుమ - అమ్మండి (స్కోరు -1 / 5.5)
ఎందుకు: ముఖ్య కారణం: ధర ఈ ఏడాది గరిష్ఠ స్థాయి దగ్గర ఉంది.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర Rs 2,738 (-5.0%) కి తగ్గితే నిల్వ ఉంచండి. ధర 15% పెరిగినా ఇదే సూచన.
నమ్మకం: తక్కువ. గతంలో SELL రోజుల్లో (987 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 54% సార్లు ధర తగ్గింది; ఏ రోజైనా 43% (తేడా +11).
ధర: క్వింటాల్‌కు Rs 2,883; 7 రోజుల్లో +13.8%, 30 రోజుల్లో +8.1%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 2,923 (Rs 2,728 - Rs 3,148).
శ్రీకాకుళంకు చౌకగా: Itarsi APMC - రవాణాతో కలిపి Rs 2,962.
హైదరాబాద్కు చౌకగా: Itarsi APMC - రవాణాతో కలిపి Rs 2,878.
సాధారణంగా Apr, May లో ధర తక్కువ, Nov, Dec లో ఎక్కువ.
